en.name: Apple iPad (10th generation) 64GB
en.shortDescription: 10.9" iPad with A14 Bionic chip, great for reading, browsing and light work.
en.description:
## Apple iPad (10th generation)

A 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display powered by the A14 Bionic chip.

- 4 GB RAM, 64 GB or 256 GB storage
- 12 MP front and back cameras
- Works with Apple Pencil (1st generation, with adapter)
- All-day battery life

Shaashad Liquid Retina oo 10.9 inch ah oo uu shaqaysiiyo chip-ka A14 Bionic.

- Kaamiro hore iyo dambe oo 12 MP ah

- Baytari maalin dhan socota
